dialect.label: Fagor 8055 / 8055i
dialect.about: Fagor's earlier control. Its own language: ( ) holds statements such as (CALL 3) and (P100 = P101 + 2), ; starts a comment, an N at the end of a line repeats it, P parameters (XP1), G70/G71 units, G43/G44 tool length, and drilling cycles where Z is the reference plane and I the depth. G04 K is in hundredths of a second.

M99.text: The Fagor 8055 ends a subroutine with (RET), not M99.

M17.text: M17 ends a subroutine on the Fagor 8060/8065. The 8055 uses (RET).

M29.text: M29 ends a subroutine on the Fagor 8060/8065. The 8055 uses (RET).

G80.text: The Fagor 8055 lathe has no G80: its cycles aren't modal, so there's nothing to cancel.

G98.text: G98 is a mill code. On the Fagor 8055 lathe, G94 is feed per minute.

G99.text: G99 is a mill code. On the Fagor 8055 lathe, G95 is feed per rev.

G43.text: The Fagor 8055 lathe has no G43: the tool's D offset always applies its length.

G76.text: On the Fagor 8055 lathe, G76 is a probing move, not a threading cycle. Threading cycles are G86 and G87.

G73.text: The Fagor 8055 lathe has no G73.

G60.about: Live tool drilling or tapping on the face: J holes, the first at spindle angle Q, then every A degrees. B0 taps.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
K: Dwell at the bottom, in hundredths of a second.
H: How far the tool backs off after each peck. None: back to the approach point.
BACKOFF
C: How close the rapid comes to the last peck.
R: Drilling: each peck is R times the last. Tapping: R0 normal, R1 rigid with orientation, R2 rigid without.
Q: Spindle angle of the first point.
J: Number of points, counting the first.
S: Live tool speed in rpm; the sign gives the direction.
LIVERPM

C: How close the rapid comes to the last peck.
R: Drilling: each peck is R times the last. Tapping: R0 normal, R1 rigid with orientation, R2 rigid without.

J: Number of points, counting the first.
S: Live tool speed in rpm; the sign gives the direction.
LIVERPM

S: Live tool speed in rpm; the sign gives the direction.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
F: Feed along the slot; the plunge uses the feed before the cycle.

G66.about: Roughs by repeating the profile from label S to label E, offset by C each pass, until the stock I is gone, then finishes at feed H. Ends at the call point.

A: Main direction: A0 along Z, A1 along X.
H: Finish pass feed. None or 0: no finish pass.
FINFEED
S: Label of the first line of the profile.
PROFFROM
E: Label of the last line of the profile.
Q: Program that holds the profile, when it isn't this one.

G68.about: Roughs along X following the profile from label S to label E, leaving L and M for the finish pass at feed H. The machining feed comes from before the cycle.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
H: Finish pass feed. None or 0: no finish pass.
FINFEED
F: Feed for the last roughing pass. None or 0: no last pass.
S: Label of the first line of the profile.
PROFFROM
E: Label of the last line of the profile.
Q: Program that holds the profile, when it isn't this one.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
H: Finish pass feed. None or 0: no finish pass.
FINFEED
F: Feed for the last roughing pass. None or 0: no last pass.
S: Label of the first line of the profile.
PROFFROM
E: Label of the last line of the profile.
Q: Program that holds the profile, when it isn't this one.

G81.about: Straight turning from the start point X Z to the end point Q R in passes of C.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
H: Finish pass feed. None or 0: no finish pass.
FINFEED
F: Feed for the last roughing pass. None or 0: no last pass.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
H: Finish pass feed. None or 0: no finish pass.
FINFEED
F: Feed for the last roughing pass. None or 0: no last pass.

G83.about: Drilling (B is the peck) or tapping (B0) along Z at X Z, to depth I.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
K: Dwell at the bottom, in hundredths of a second.
H: How far the tool backs off after each peck. None: back to the approach point.
BACKOFF
C: How close the rapid comes to the last peck.
R: Drilling: each peck is R times the last. Tapping: R0 normal, R1 rigid with orientation, R2 rigid without.

G84.about: Turning from X Z to Q R with an arc whose center is I K from the start point.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
H: Finish pass feed. None or 0: no finish pass.
FINFEED
F: Feed for the last roughing pass. None or 0: no last pass.
I: Arc center in X, from the start point (radius).
K: Arc center in Z, from the start point.

G85.about: Facing from X Z to Q R with an arc whose center is I K from the start point.

D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
H: Finish pass feed. None or 0: no finish pass.
FINFEED
F: Feed for the last roughing pass. None or 0: no last pass.
I: Arc center in X, from the start point (radius).
K: Arc center in Z, from the start point.

G86.about: Threading along Z from X Z to Q R, depth I in passes of B, pitch C.

K: Z where the thread is measured, for thread repair.
B: Pass depth: + passes get smaller, - equal passes.
E: Smallest pass when B is positive.
L: Finish pass: + at angle A, - radial, 0 repeats the last pass.
C: Thread pitch: + along the taper, - along the axis.
W: Spindle angle at the measure point, or the start angle of each start on a multi-start thread.
H: Infeed: 0 radial, 1 first flank, 2 to 5 zig-zag.
INFEED
U: U1: repair a thread, or start directly on a cylinder.

G87.about: Threading on the face from X Z to Q R, depth I in passes of B, pitch C.

K: Z where the thread is measured, for thread repair.
B: Pass depth: + passes get smaller, - equal passes.
E: Smallest pass when B is positive.
L: Finish pass: + at angle A, - radial, 0 repeats the last pass.
C: Thread pitch: + along the taper, - along the axis.
W: Spindle angle at the measure point, or the start angle of each start on a multi-start thread.
H: Infeed: 0 radial, 1 first flank, 2 to 5 zig-zag.
INFEED
U: U1: repair a thread, or start directly on a cylinder.

G88.about: Grooving along X: plunges from X to Q, stepping along Z from Z to R.

C: Step between plunges. None: the tool's width.
D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
K: Dwell at the bottom, in hundredths of a second.

G89.about: Grooving along Z: plunges from Z to R, stepping along X from X to Q.

C: Step between plunges. None: the tool's width.
D: Safety distance the tool pulls back.
K: Dwell at the bottom, in hundredths of a second.
Dwell at the bottom, in hundredths of a second (K50 is half a second).

G69.about: Drilling with a peck that changes: the first peck is B, each later one R times the last, never less than L. Every J pecks the tool goes back to the reference plane.

C: How close the rapid comes to the last peck.
D: Distance from the reference plane to the surface.
H: How far the tool backs off after each peck.
BACKOFF
J: Go back to the reference plane every J pecks.
R: Peck factor: each peck is R times the last.

G81.about: Fagor drilling: rapid to the reference plane Z, feed to the depth I, dwell K, rapid back out.

G82.about: Drilling with a dwell: rapid to the reference plane Z, feed to the depth I, dwell K at the bottom, rapid back out.

G83.about: Deep-hole drilling: J pecks of I each, back to the reference plane after each one.

G84.about: Tapping to depth I. R0 is normal tapping, R1 rigid tapping with a spindle orientation, R2 rigid tapping without one; J, B and H apply to rigid tapping.

R: R0 normal tapping, R1 rigid with orientation, R2 rigid without.

G86.about: Boring to depth I, dwell K. With Q the spindle stops at angle Q and the tool moves off by D and E before coming out; without, it comes out at rapid with the spindle stopped.

Q: Spindle angle for the way out.

G87.about: Rectangular pocket: half length J, half width K, passes of B down to I, finishing stock L. I is measured from the starting plane.

G89.about: Boring with a dwell: feed to the depth I, dwell K, feed back out.
